payload.name: reasoning
payload.description: A concise visible plan for the current turn: resolve prior conversational references, identify target columns/rows, and name the needed operation.

payload.name: answer
payload.description: Return the final answer for the current turn as a JSON array of strings. For one answer, return a one-element array. Preserve each complete table-cell value as one string.

payload.content: Use the `reasoning` field as a short plan for the current turn. Resolve references from conversation history when needed, then put only the final answer list in `answer`.
Return only the fields shown in the output format instructions. Keep intermediate reasoning in the reasoning/workpad field(s), and keep the final result in the final output field.

rationale: Visible plan-answer scaffold for testing whether an explicit plan field changes SQA reasoning behavior beyond the default answer-only surface.
